outcomes.text: Trace how computers evolved and name the generations.
Tell analog, digital and hybrid computers apart.
Classify digital computers as mainframe, mini and micro.
Describe how computers are used in education, business, defence, media and manufacturing.
Describe the scope of IT careers such as software engineer, network administrator, database administrator and web designer.
Describe input devices, system unit, processor parts, storage and output devices.
Describe memory units, ROM, RAM and cache.
Distinguish a port, an expansion slot and an expansion card.
Draw block diagrams of the input, processing, storage and output operations.
Define the OS, device drivers, utility programs and language processors.
Identify productivity, business, entertainment and education software.
Explain open source software, shareware and freeware.
